shortDesc: A Q-switched Nd:YAG laser with 1064 and 532 nm handpieces and a fractional tip, delivered through an articulated arm, at our Ahmedabad clinic.
intro: The Mermaid is a Q-switched Nd:YAG laser at Skin Essence in Ahmedabad, made by RUIKD and delivered through an articulated arm that keeps the beam steady over long sessions. Q-switching packs the energy into nanosecond pulses that shatter pigment by a photoacoustic effect rather than heat, which is what lets it treat tan, sun spots and post-acne marks with little downtime.

The system's standard tips cover 1064 nm for deeper pigment and toning and 532 nm for superficial spots, plus a fractional tip that concentrates the energy into a grid of micro-zones to stimulate collagen for acne scars and texture. Settings are chosen for each patient by the dermatologist.
whatItTreats: Tan, sun spots, freckles and age spots
Melasma, as low-energy toning within a maintenance plan
Acne scars and rough texture with the fractional tip

howItWorks.title: Photoacoustic shattering
howItWorks.description: Nanosecond pulses break pigment into particles small enough for the body to clear, with minimal heating of the surrounding skin.

howItWorks.title: Two wavelengths and a fractional tip
howItWorks.description: 1064 nm reaches deeper pigment, 532 nm clears superficial spots, and the fractional tip stimulates collagen for scars and texture.

howItWorks.title: Articulated arm delivery
howItWorks.description: The arm carries the beam to the handpiece with a stable, even output, which helps precision over the face and larger areas.

faqs.q: Is it safe for Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes, at the right energy. The 1064 nm wavelength is absorbed less by the skin's own melanin, and sessions are planned conservatively by the dermatologist, with a test patch where needed.

faqs.q: How many toning sessions are needed?
faqs.a: Usually 6 to 8 sessions spaced 2 to 4 weeks apart, with visible brightening after two or three. Melasma needs ongoing maintenance.
